sections.title: Estimating sums
facts: Round each number to the nearest ten (or hundred), then add or subtract.

sections.title: Compatible numbers
facts: Change the number being divided to a nearby multiple: $247 \div 6 \approx 240 \div 6 = 40$.
To share into groups with some left over, the number of groups needed rounds up.

sections.title: Checking
facts: Last digit of a product: multiply the last digits. Last digit of a sum: add the last digits.
Compare the answer with an estimate: is it about the right size?
